records.title: PrismPrune: Decoupling Saliency and Diversity in Attention for Efficient Visual Token Pruning in VLMs
records.reason: PrismPrune decouples saliency and diversity signals inside multi-head attention to prune visual tokens in VLMs, attacking the quadratic visual-token bottleneck; direct inference-time token pruning for VLMs.

records.title: How Smoothing is N-simplicial Attention?
records.reason: Introduces N-simplicial attention with cost-effective simplex selection and analyzes its smoothing via Lipschitz bounds; an attention-variant architecture/theory study without an inference-system evaluation.

records.title: A Modern Multimodal Assistant on a 6 GB 2011 GPU: Stage-Validated, All-GPU CUDA Inference for Fermi
records.reason: Reports an all-GPU CUDA inference engine running a multimodal MoE assistant entirely on a 6GB Fermi GPU, with measured GEMM and dequantization engineering; direct on-device inference systems work.

records.title: ARSM: Auto-Regressive State Machine for Agentic Reasoning Compression
records.reason: ARSM compresses agentic reasoning context in-situ with an auto-regressive state machine to relieve agent memory bottlenecks; context compression for agents, adjacent to but not an LLM serving/decoding system.

records.title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents
records.reason: Coca-Cola compresses tool observations into continuous latent tokens for LLM agents instead of raw text context; reduces agent context overhead, but is an agent-representation method rather than an inference system technique.

records.title: Greener yet Powerful: Taming Large Code Generation Models with Quantization
records.reason: Quantizes large code generation models so they run on laptops and mid-size servers, explicitly targeting memory, latency and dollar cost of deployment; inference-oriented model quantization.

records.title: oBERTa: Improving Sparse Transfer Learning via improved initialization, distillation, and pruning regimes
records.reason: oBERTa combines pruning, distillation and quantization regimes to produce RoBERTa models 3.8-24.3x faster for practitioners; direct inference-speed model compression.

records.title: ADiP: Adaptive Precision Systolic Array for Matrix Multiplication Acceleration
records.reason: ADiP is an adaptive-precision systolic array that reconfigures processing elements for quantized matrix multiplication in Transformers; accelerator hardware for transformer inference computation.

records.title: Pruning Everything, Everywhere, All at Once
records.reason: Prunes neurons and layers simultaneously across generic deep networks; a general structured-pruning method not specialized to or evaluated as an LLM inference technique.

records.title: Multilayer Dataflow: Orchestrate Butterfly Sparsity to Accelerate Attention Computation
records.reason: Multilayer Dataflow orchestrates butterfly sparsity on a reconfigurable dataflow architecture to accelerate attention computation and cut its memory demands; attention acceleration hardware.

records.title: AMix-2: Establishing Protein as a Native Modality in Large Language Models
records.reason: AMix-2 establishes protein sequences as a native modality of LLMs for biological reasoning and protein design; a biomedical foundation-model application with no inference-system content.

records.title: Scheduling Recursive Reasoning in Looped Transformers
records.reason: TAPS schedules update scales along recurrent reasoning trajectories in looped Transformers at test time; it modulates test-time computation, but the contribution is a reasoning-dynamics method rather than a serving system.

records.title: Reinforced MLLM: A Survey on RL-Based Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
records.reason: A survey of reinforcement-learning-based reasoning in multimodal LLMs covering algorithms and reward designs; a capability survey with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Binarized Mamba-Transformer for Lightweight Quad Bayer HybridEVS Demosaicing
records.reason: A binarized Mamba-Transformer performs Quad Bayer demosaicing for hybrid event cameras on mobile devices; an image-signal-processing application, not LLM inference.

records.title: SeLMRoute: Probabilistic Semantic Evidence for Large Language Model Routing
records.reason: SeLMRoute extracts candidate-independent semantic evidence from queries to learn LLM routing decisions under deployment objectives; routing research, but the abstract centers on evidence representation rather than serving-cost mechanics.

records.title: Ruler: A Model-Agnostic Method to Control Generated Length for Large Language Models
records.reason: Ruler adds meta length tokens so LLMs follow target response lengths; an instruction-following capability method with no inference efficiency or systems contribution.

records.title: Division-of-Thoughts: Harnessing Hybrid Language Model Synergy for Efficient On-Device LLM Agents
records.reason: Division-of-Thoughts decomposes tasks between on-device SLMs and cloud LLMs with a scheduler and adapter, cutting reasoning time and API cost; hybrid routing for agents, with inference savings secondary to the agent framework.

records.title: PoWER-BERT: Accelerating BERT Inference via Progressive Word-vector Elimination
records.reason: PoWER-BERT progressively eliminates redundant intermediate word-vectors, chosen by attention-based significance, to cut BERT inference time up to 4.5x at under 1% accuracy loss; a direct inference acceleration method.

records.title: Spatial-TTT: Streaming Visual-based Spatial Intelligence with Test-Time Training
records.reason: Spatial-TTT maintains spatial evidence over unbounded video streams with test-time training and sliding-window attention; an efficient streaming architecture for a spatial-intelligence application, not LLM inference.

records.title: Hierarchical Memory Orchestration for Personalized Persistent Agents
records.reason: Hierarchical Memory Orchestration tiers interaction history with a compact primary cache for personalized agents on constrained devices; agent memory management adjacent to inference cost, but no serving/decoding mechanism.

records.title: Behemoth: A Flash-centric Training Accelerator for Extreme-scale DNNs
records.reason: Behemoth pairs a training accelerator with a NAND-flash memory system to train extreme-scale DNNs, reporting training throughput and cost versus TPU v3; training-only hardware with no inference application.

records.title: Unstructured Pruning and Low Rank Factorisation of Self-Supervised Pre-Trained Speech Models
records.reason: Applies unstructured pruning plus low-rank factorization (via truncated SVD) to self-supervised speech models to cut memory and compute; compression is generic, but the target is speech-task models, not LLM inference.

records.title: CrisPrune: Combining Contextual Relevance and Intrinsic Saliency for Efficient Visual Token Pruning in MLLMs
records.reason: CrisPrune is a training-free visual token pruning method for MLLMs combining intrinsic visual saliency with contextual relevance to relieve the multimodal inference bottleneck; direct inference-time token pruning.

records.title: AssoMem: Scalable Memory QA with Multi-Signal Associative Retrieval
records.reason: AssoMem builds an associative memory graph with multi-signal retrieval for large-scale memory question answering; a memory-retrieval framework for assistants, not an inference execution or serving technique.

records.title: Bilinear Input Modulation for Mamba: Koopman Bilinear Forms for Memory Retention and Multiplicative Computation
records.reason: Bilinear Input Modulation augments Mamba SSMs with a state-input product (Koopman form) with parallel-scan-compatible variants; an architecture improvement for sequence modeling, not an inference system contribution.

records.title: LCT: Losslessly Compressed Tensors with GPU friendly execution for Training
records.reason: Losslessly Compressed Tensors compress weights, activations and optimizer states with GPU Huffman kernels to save memory during training and fine-tuning; training-only memory reduction with no inference use stated.

records.title: Efficient and Generalizable Speaker Diarization via Structured Pruning of Self-Supervised Models
records.reason: Structured pruning guided by distillation compresses WavLM-based speaker diarization models (80% smaller, 4x faster inference); the compression method is sound but the application is a speech diarization model, not LLM inference.

records.title: Learning distributed representations with efficient SoftMax normalization
records.reason: Proposes a linear-time heuristic for SoftMax normalization constants when learning distributed embeddings; a representation-learning algorithm, not an inference-system technique.

records.title: Enhancing depression detection in social media through BERT model pruning
records.reason: Introduces an attention-head-importance pruning strategy for BERT aimed at edge deployment, but the work is framed and evaluated as depression detection on social media; application-led with a compression component.

records.title: MMDuet2: Enhancing Proactive Interaction of Video MLLMs with Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: MMDuet2 uses multi-turn RL to make video MLLMs proactively decide when to reply during playback; an interaction-capability method with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
records.reason: Empirically varies coding-agent harness components (planning, action space, context management) on SWE-Bench; an agent-design study, not an inference system technique.

records.title: Towards Universal Video MLLMs with Attribute-Structured and Quality-Verified Instructions
records.reason: Builds ASID-1M structured audiovisual instruction data and a verification pipeline for universal video MLLMs; dataset/curation work with no inference-system content.

records.title: TIDAL: Temporally Interleaved Diffusion and Action Loop for High-Frequency VLA Control
records.reason: TIDAL is a dual-frequency scheduler that caches semantic embeddings and interleaves diffusion planning with high-frequency VLA actuation to cut control latency; inference scheduling, but for a robotics control application.

records.title: Scaling Laws for Collapse in Asynchronous GRPO
records.reason: Derives scaling laws linking policy staleness and learning rate to collapse in asynchronous GRPO post-training; training-stability analysis with no inference application.

records.title: FocusGraph: Graph-Structured Frame Selection for Embodied Long Video Question Answering
records.reason: FocusGraph selects informative keyframes via scene-graph captions to make embodied long-video QA faster and lighter; frame selection reduces MLLM input cost, but the work targets a QA application.

records.title: Latent Preference Modeling for Cross-Session Personalized Tool Calling
records.reason: MPT benchmarks cross-session personalized tool calling and PRefine maintains latent user preferences as test-time memory; agent memory/personalization work, not an inference system technique.

records.title: VideoSeeker: Incentivizing Instance-level Video Understanding via Native Agentic Tool Invocation
records.reason: VideoSeeker enables instance-level spatiotemporal video understanding via native agentic tool invocation; a perception-capability paradigm with no inference efficiency contribution.

records.title: ToolGen: Unified Tool Retrieval and Calling via Generation
records.reason: ToolGen represents each tool as a unique token so LLMs generate retrieval and calls within next-token prediction, avoiding separate retrieval; it changes the tool-use interface, with inference-system impact only indirect.

records.title: Not all tokens are needed(NAT): token efficient reinforcement learning
records.reason: NAT updates RL policies on a selected subset of generated tokens via Horvitz-Thompson reweighting to cut RL training cost; training efficiency only, with no inference application.

records.title: VeriPhy: Agentic Physical Reasoning for World Model Evaluation and Refinement
records.reason: VeriPhy verifies physical obligations in generated videos with typed measurements and frozen experts; a world-model evaluation/refinement system, not LLM inference.

records.title: ARID: A Deployable Edge AI System for Structured Information Extraction from Industrial Maintenance Work Orders
records.reason: ARID is a deployable Jetson system extracting structured fields from maintenance work orders using 4-bit inference and grammar-constrained decoding; an application system whose inference engineering is use-case specific.

records.title: GNN-LM: Language Modeling based on Global Contexts via GNN
records.reason: GNN-LM augments language modeling with graph aggregation over retrieved neighbor contexts; a modeling architecture for generalization, not an inference system.

records.title: Token Turing Machines
records.reason: Token Turing Machines keep a bounded token memory read/written by a Transformer controller for long visual sequences at bounded per-step cost; an efficient architecture, but a general sequence model rather than an LLM inference system.

records.title: A 2-Dimensional State Space Layer for Spatial Inductive Bias
records.reason: Presents a 2-dimensional state space layer giving visual Transformers spatial inductive bias with efficient parameterization (same work family as the 2-D SSM layer judged from its arXiv abstract); a vision architecture component, not LLM inference.

records.title: LOCOST: State-Space Models for Long Document Abstractive Summarization
records.reason: LOCOST is an SSM encoder-decoder for long-document summarization reporting large inference memory savings over sparse Transformers; efficiency is real, but the contribution is a task-specific summarization architecture.

records.title: Retrieval-of-Thought: Efficient Reasoning via Reusing Thoughts
records.reason: Retrieval-of-Thought reuses prior reasoning steps from a thought graph at inference time, assembling templates that cut output tokens and latency while preserving accuracy; a direct inference-time efficiency method for reasoning models.

records.title: Efficient and Private Federated Learning with Partially Trainable Networks
records.reason: FedPT freezes part of the network during federated learning to cut communication cost across mobile devices; training efficiency for federated learning, not inference.

records.title: Halu-J: Critique-Based Hallucination Judge
records.reason: Halu-J is a critique-based judge for detecting LLM hallucinations against retrieved evidence; an evaluation/detection method with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: START: A Generalized State Space Model with Saliency-Driven Token-Aware Transformation
records.reason: START is an SSM with saliency-driven token transformation for domain generalization in vision; a generalization architecture for image tasks, not inference systems.

records.title: When Importance Sampling Misallocates Credit: Asymmetric Ratios for Outcome-Supervised RL
records.reason: Analyzes how importance-sampling ratios misallocate credit in outcome-supervised RL (GRPO-style) post-training; a training-algorithm study with no inference application.
